verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships a first-party, built-in MCP server with a dedicated documentation page. It lets AI assistants browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, resolve issues, and run tools like detect_n_plus_one across error, performance, and log data, and a probe confirms the official docs exist. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and documented connection/auth setup details (transport, client configuration) in the evidence.
